verdict.rationale: CRA's own pages state that Business Registration Online is "the fastest and easiest way" to get a business number and register GST/HST, payroll and corporation income tax accounts on one form. Its e-services pages also list filing a return, making a payment and submitting documents online, and EFILE covers software-based return transmission. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the online registration, filing and payment flows complete end-to-end for a founder.
